integrity: Self-contained proof with independently reproducible finite verification. No independent external scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Four-color exact enumeration is established for p=2 and even q only; a closed census for all even-even p,q is open; priority overlap with unindexed subdivision or multitheta-coloring literature remains possible.
title: Parity classification and exact optimal strong odd coloring census for fully subdivided complete bipartite graphs
